name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – After § 74 – Am 77
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 74a. Deplores the choice of using Article 122 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union as the legal basis for the ‘new financial EU instrument to support Member States in boosting their defence capabilities’; expresses grave concern that Parliament has been excluded from the decision-making process with regard to such a strategic decision and considers this to be a dangerous undermining of EU democracy;
